'''Burnout''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Thaereian system]] that orbited [[Zham Hlar]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Thaereian military]] kept an [[Acklay/Legends|Acklay]] there and fed prisoners to it. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] landed there to refuel, but the [[Thaereian Intelligence]] agent [[Xirossk]] sabotaged their ship and when they tracked him, tried to defect to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
